claims.claim_text_normalized: Adding batch normalization on all convolutional layers in YOLO improves mAP by more than 2%.
claims.evidence_quote_short: By adding batch normalization on all of the convolutional layers in YOLO we get more than 2% improvement in mAP.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Fine tuning the classification network at 448×448 resolution for 10 epochs on ImageNet increases mAP by almost 4%.
claims.evidence_quote_short: This high resolution classification network gives us an increase of almost 4% mAP.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Using dimension clusters along with directly predicting the bounding box center location improves YOLO by almost 5% over the version with anchor boxes.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Using dimension clusters along with directly predicting the bounding box center location improves YOLO by almost 5% over the version with anchor boxes.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLOv2 at 40 FPS achieves 78.6 mAP on VOC 2007, outperforming Faster R-CNN with ResNet and SSD while running significantly faster.
claims.evidence_quote_short: At 40 FPS, YOLOv2 gets 78.6 mAP, outperforming state-of-the-art methods like Faster R-CNN with ResNet and SSD while still running significantly faster.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO9000 achieves 19.7 mAP on the ImageNet detection validation set despite only having detection data for 44 of the 200 classes.
claims.evidence_quote_short: YOLO9000 gets 19.7 mAP on the ImageNet detection validation set despite only having detection data for 44 of the 200 classes.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO9000 gets 16.0 mAP on the 156 classes not in COCO.
claims.evidence_quote_short: On the 156 classes not in COCO, YOLO9000 gets 16.0 mAP.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO9000 predicts detections for more than 9000 different object categories and still runs in real-time.
claims.evidence_quote_short: But YOLO can detect more than just 200 classes; it predicts detections for more than 9000 different object categories. And it still runs in real-time.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The proposed multi-scale training method allows the same YOLOv2 model to run at varying sizes, offering an easy tradeoff between speed and accuracy.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Using a novel, multi-scale training method the same YOLOv2 model can run at varying sizes, offering an easy tradeoff between speed and accuracy.

claims.claim_text_normalized: YOLO9000 learns new species of animals well but struggles with learning categories like clothing and equipment.
claims.evidence_quote_short: When we analyze YOLO9000’s performance on ImageNet we see it learns new species of animals well but struggles with learning categories like clothing and equipment.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The joint training method allows YOLO9000 to predict detections for object classes that do not have labelled detection data.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Our joint training allows YOLO9000 to predict detections for object classes that don’t have labelled detection data.
